# vb-sample: a small made-up Visual Builder app for Build.Rite's tests

A "shop" app (webApps/shop): a shell page, two flows (customers, orders) and five pages with chains, a service
connection (services/shopApi), Component Exchange components (webApps/shop/settings/dependencies.json), role codes in
its code (SHOP_ADMIN, SHOP_CLERK, SHOP_VIEWER) and the BI Publisher report it reads its user's roles from
(/Custom/Shop/USER_ROLES.xdo). Nothing here is a real company's.
